name: fixture-pkg
description: Test-fixture extension package installed via npm file: by the packages-dir tests. Host runtime modules (pi-durable/pi-ai) are DEV-dependencies only (the provider-plugins posture): npm never installs a tarball's devDependencies, so no install shape bundles a second pi-durable for the loader's host-module guard to trip over — the packages dir's host-module links provide them.
